value.rationale: The heterogeneous price dependence and unique support transition for a natural network with multiple two-edge routes and one optional shunt give an exact design criterion. Interior conductances and optimum objective are explicit; a single monotone scalar determines the inactive regime and exact price threshold independently of budget. The equal-price threshold decreases quadratically with the number of routes, revealing a nontrivial network-planning effect.
